notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.3.3
notes.notes:
Accessory Added:
Added a new "Flashy Bangle" accessory, purchasable from the jeweler in Capital City, or from traveling accessory merchants. It gives -20 to your stealth stat, preventing passive evasion of hostile enemies.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.3.1
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug from the new update where the game would crash upon viewing a traveling merchant's wares or robbing them.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.3.0
notes.notes:
Quality of Life Improvements
Keyboard Shortcuts Menu: Added a new section in Settings that lists all available keyboard shortcut options.

Toggle Kind Mode Anytime: Players can now turn Kind Mode on or off at any point via the smiley face icon next to their character's name in the top-left corner. Note: This option is unavailable if the character has Permadeath Mode enabled, as the two modes are incompatible.

Creature Morality Indicators: Creatures now display a red/gray/green color-coded morality alignment during initial encounters.

Speed Status Indicator: Your character's speed stat now shows if you’re currently affected by a temporary slow or speed boost by saying (Slowed) or (Boosted) by your current speed.
[p align="start"]
Kind Mode Upgrades
XP Boost: +30% XP gain while Kind Mode is active.

Increased Legendary Encounters: Encounter chance for legendary creatures raised from 3% to 5%.

Passive Regen: Recover 2% HP and Mana per turn while traveling or waiting.
[p align="start"]
Combat & Encounters Changes
XP for Fleeing Creatures: Players now gain partial XP when creatures flee mid-combat.

Enemy Flee Chance Reduced: Slightly lowered global enemy flee success rates by 10%. (Level and speed differentials still apply to this chance as before.)

Area Level Adjustments:

Merchant Port: Level range reduced from 1-15 to 1-10

Rocky Path: Level range reduced from 1-15 to 1-10

Encounter Damage Scaling: Damage from encounters (for example, snake bites, carnivorous plants, or getting sick in the rain) now scale based on your level difference, instead of a flat damage amount.
[p align="start"]
New Items & Equipment
New Consumables: A handful of new consumable items have been added to the game.

New Gear:

15+ new weapons and ammo types added, including enchanted gear.

A new shield.

Some weapons now have special effects, similar to spells, including: Burning, Poisoning, Paralysis, Health Absorption, and more!

Old Gear Rebalanced:

Many previously existing weapons received damage increases and higher gold value for better balance against equivalent-tier spells.

Some old weapons also gained new types and/or special effects.

Encounter Item Pool Expansion: More variety has been added to loot found during various encounters.
[p align="start"]
New Spells
5 New Spells Added (one for each magic type)


New World Content
11 New Encounters

3 New Quests
[p align="start"]
Bug Fixes
Fixed issues with the Health/Mana full chime and status box flashing triggering at incorrect times.

Fixed a crash related to certain achievements being unlocked.


What's Next[p align="start"]It's the last Friday in August, so this is the final weekly content update, I hope you all have enjoyed them! I don't have an exact date for the next content and feature update yet, but I know it will be coming sometime before the end of September.
[p align="start"]If you've been enjoying your adventure please consider leaving a review, it would really help!

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.2.1

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.1.0
notes.notes:
New Content
Added 4 new creatures to the world.

Added a new quest – discoverable in [spoiler]Paradise Lake[/spoiler].

Added a new special accessory item.

Added a couple new consumable items.

Added 5 new encounters discoverable across the world, including in [spoiler]Springdance Plains, Feywood Forest, Capital City Outskirts, Rocky Path[/spoiler], and other places and regions.


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the Compendium would sometimes fail to open, displaying “Compendium not available for demo” instead.

Fixed a bug where the “Lost Merchant” encounter could not be completed. This quest has been re-added to the quest pool for players who had to remove it.

Fixed a bug that sometimes resulted in a game crash upon creating a magic wielding character.

Fixed an issue that made magic mushrooms impossible to find when gathering mushrooms.


Looking Ahead
More content updates are coming every Friday this month!
This week focused on launch stability and bug fixes, but next week’s update will bring significantly more content, including new encounters, quests, and other additions.

notes.title: Mythscroll v1.0.0 Launches August 11 - Patch Notes & Info
notes.notes:
Here’s everything new, updated, and fixed in the upcoming full launch of Mythscroll! The full game adds new systems, balances progression, introduces new content and achievements, and improves overall player experience.


Gameplay & Mechanics
Evade Ambushes with Stealth
You now have a chance to evade surprise attacks and ambushes from aggressive creatures based on your Stealth stat.

Armor Speed Rework
Rebalanced how armor affects speed:

Light and heavy armor skills now have a greater impact.

Wearing heavy armor without proper skill is more punishing; mastering armor gives more noticeable benefits.

Enchanted Weapon System

You can now damage fully physically immune creatures (e.g., ghosts, wraiths, will-o-wisps) using enchanted weapons or ammo.

Enchanted arrows also work in regular bows.

Creature Morality Behavior

Creatures who are closer to your morality are more agreeable and easier to talk to and persuade.

Some creatures may now flee before or during combat, especially when threatened or confronted by evil-aligned players.

Creature Interaction Options

New option: Ask for directions during creature encounters.

Renamed "Threaten creature" to "Rob creature", and made it a standalone option (no need to talk the creature first).

Creatures can now also attempt to rob you of gold or items.

Merchant & Theft Balance

Merchant inventories now scale with area level, no more buying top-tier gear in starter areas.

Robbing merchants or trying to learn a language for free is now more difficult.

Resting Improvements

Resting is now 30% more likely to succeed in all areas.

You can always rest safely in towns and designated safe zones.

Boost your Stealth stat to rest successfully even more often in the wild.


World, Encounters & Content
New Creatures

Added: Basilisk, Cursed Armor, Valkyrie, and Carnivorous Plant, bringing the total number of unique, non-faction creatures to 85.

New Encounters

Added 60+ new branching encounters, bringing the total number of random encounters to 100+

More coming: 50+ additional encounters arriving in updates over the next few weeks.

New Jobs & Quests

Added 20+ new jobs and quests.

More coming: 10+ more quests on the way in the next few weeks.

Fishing System

You can now go fishing if:

You have a fishing pole. Hint:[spoiler]A fishing pole can be acquired by completing a quest found along the rocky path.[/spoiler]

You're near a body of water (river, lake, ocean coastline) or find a pond in a random encounter.

Fast Travel System

Unlocked once you've completed the full world map.


Spells & Equipment
New Spells Added

Effects include: Confuse, Slow, Weaken, Burn, Paralyze, Unconscious, Drain Health, Heal Self

Spellbook now supports hover tooltips: View each spell’s attack type, damage, speed, mana cost, and effects.

Equipment Panel Improvements

Click items in your equipment panel to automatically open your inventory to that item.

Weapon Naming Fix

Sickles renamed to Scythes, now properly reflected as two-handed weapons.

More Gear & Items

A variety of new gear and items have been added throughout the world.


Achievements
Achievements Now Live!

120 in-game achievements

100 Steam achievements

Track your progress across combat, exploration, questing, crafting, and more.


Misc Fixes & Improvements
Updated Tutorial

Refreshed and expanded for better onboarding.

Code Refactoring

Cleaned up and optimized some complex internal systems.

Bug Fixes

Addressed various reported bugs and inconsistencies.


More Upcoming Changes
Known bugs - These minor bugs are not yet fixed, but have fixes planned over the next couple weeks:

Visual / text glitches where the tops or bottoms of some words or numbers are slightly cut off, but still legible.

Rare instances where items are not referenced grammatically correctly, for example misuses a vs an.

Additional content - More encounters and quests are planned to be added over the next few weeks.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1
notes.notes:
Major New Feature: The Compendium
The Compendium has been made available to provide information on key game elements:

The Attributes and Skills tabs are pre-filled with information about the attributes and skills in the game.

The Locations, Creatures, and Factions tabs will populate automatically as your character discovers them.

Note for existing saves: Locations you've already discovered will appear in the compendium upon loading your save file after updating the game, but creatures will not. That data wasn't tracked prior to this update, so all players will start with an empty creature log.


World & Gameplay Changes
Cities are now safe zones. Creatures in cities now have a minimum morality set to 'neutral', ensuring players won’t be attacked in safe areas, unless your character has very low morality, in which case 'righteous' morality creatures (e.g. knights, guards, angels) will still target you.


Quality of Life & Bug Fixes
New Keyboard Shortcut: Press F1 to toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode. This can be used to resolve rare cases where the game launches to a black screen in fullscreen.

Level-Up Screen Fixes:

Fixed a bug where base stats were incorrectly displayed on the level-up screen.

Added a “Real-Time Stats” toggle on the level-up screen to allow you to switch between viewing your base stats and your current stats (with accessory and temporary bonuses applied).


Now Available on Linux!
Mythscroll now supports Linux! A Linux build is available alongside Windows. If you’re playing on Linux, I’d love to hear your feedback and reports on performance or issues.


What’s Next?
This will likely be the final update for the demo, as I shift focus toward completing the full version of Mythscroll for release. Please continue to share your feedback and bug reports; it is still very helpful. Thank you so much to everyone who’s played, shared feedback, and helped shape the game so far!

If you haven’t already, don’t forget to join the Discord to follow development and share your thoughts. I will soon be launching another poll to allow players to vote on the next creature added to the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.2.3
notes.notes:
New Features
Steam Cloud Saves are now enabled for the demo! Your progress will sync across devices automatically.


World & Encounter Changes
Creatures now display a power descriptor upon initial encounter based on level difference:

+5 levels: "a strong (creature)"

+10 levels: "a powerful (creature)"

+20 levels: "a very powerful (creature)"

Certain areas can no longer be discovered via signposts; you’ll need to find them the old-fashioned way.


Gameplay & UX Enhancements
If you finish a quest while in a city, you’ll no longer need to travel again to access city options; they now appear immediately after the quest ends.

During encounters, if a stat check is required for a choice, the relevant stat is now highlighted in your attributes or skills panel when hovering over that option button.


Inventory & Item Info Improvements
Armor and clothing now display additional information in your inventory:

Armor Type (e.g. Type: Heavy Armor, Type: Clothing)

Weapons now display additional information in your inventory:

Weapon Style (e.g. Weapon Style: One Handed)

Damage Type(s) (e.g. Damage Type: Bash, Damage Types: Stab, Slash)

Jewelry that grants traits now displays the stat modifiers included with those traits.

Example: +Bookworm Trait (+1 Int, -1 Str)

These changes will only impact new items added to the inventory, this update will not affect items already in your character's inventory


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where accepting any job on a job board always assigned the first job on the board, regardless of which one was selected.

Fixed a bug where some inventory items were unclickable due to UI overlap with the “Disabled Compendium” button.

Patched an exploit where players could gain infinite XP by repeatedly bartering at city shops. You now must leave and re-enter the shop to attempt bartering again, making the exploit much slower and less viable.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.2.2​​
notes.notes:
This small patch includes a couple of bug fixes and some balance adjustments based on player feedback. 


Gameplay Improvements
Level-Up Improvement: Your character's health and mana now fully refill when you level up.

Attribute Health/Mana Scaling Adjustments:

Intelligence and Constitution now begin to increase your max mana and health earlier than before, starting at attribute levels 5 instead of 6.​

The impact of these attributes on max health and mana has increased 20%.


UI & Visual Updates
Ocean Visibility: Increased the size of wave lines in ocean to make it clearer which areas are water.

Default Screen Mode Change:

The default screen mode has been changed from fullscreen to windowed. This is a temporary workaround for a rare issue some players are experiencing where the game launches to a black screen in fullscreen.

This change will affect all new and returning players when first launching the game after the update, but you can simply switch back to fullscreen mode in Settings once, and it will remember your preference.


Bug Fixes
Health/Mana Display Bug: Fixed an issue where increases to max health or mana from leveling Intelligence or Constitution didn’t display correctly until restarting the game.

Language Merchant Fix: Resolved a bug where convincing or threatening the language merchant would show “\[insert language here]” instead of the actual language and fail to teach it.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.2.1
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603763/fa363b019ad83cfb02f00b71d97c7bb2bd9af103.png"]This demo update brings a mix of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, mechanical reworks, and new content! Here's everything that's new or changed:


Gameplay Improvements


Refined Combat Mechanics:

Armor and armor skills are now more effective at reducing damage.

Balanced enemy health and attack values.

Character Speed, Creature Speed, and Weapon Speed now play a greater role in combat turn order, with possible missed attacks or follow up attacks.

Signature weapon bonus reduced from +20% to +10% damage.

Constitution and Intelligence now restore health or mana when leveling up. (e.g. 80/100 HP → +20 max → now 100/120 HP).



Luck Stat Rework: Luck has a chance to give you a second chance on failed checks.



Health & Mana Bars: Now show numerical values (e.g. 50 / 100).



Enemy HUD: Added a toggleable setting to show enemy level and health bars. This is enabled by default.



Windowed / Fullscreen Toggle: You can now switch between windowed and fullscreen mode from the settings menu.


Exploration & World Updates
Map Enhancements:

Added a compass and distance scale (in kilometers).

The river line on the map now starts hidden and becomes visible when discovered (like other locations).

Travel & Waiting Tweaks:

Increased success chance when resting by +10%, even on failed Stealth and Luck checks.

Increased chances of nothing happening when waiting or traveling by +5%.

Greatly reduced odds of the language merchant running off without teaching the language.


Tutorials & Onboarding
Character Creator Tutorial: Brief guide added to walk players through character creation.

New Game Tutorial: Added a short tutorial that runs on starting a new game or loading a save file for the first time after updating. Returning players can choose to skip it.


Stat-Boosting Meals
Some food and drinks purchased at taverns  and inns now grant temporary stat bonuses:

Beer, cider, or wine: +1 Charisma for 10 minutes

Beef stew: +1 Strength for 10 minutes

And more!


Stat Check Rebalancing
Stat checks now cap at 2% (minimum) and 99% (maximum); there are no longer guaranteed successes or failures based purely on stats.

Increased stat check success threshold by 5%


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where undiscovered nearby locations were incorrectly marked as discovered when loading a save.

Fixed an issue where fullscreen mode wouldn’t activate properly on startup.

Fixed an issue where damage from divine curses (e.g., from failing a Religion check or underpaying at shrines) would reduce the player to 0 HP but not kill them.


Morality System Adjustments
Reduced negative morality penalties for certain actions.


New Content
Added several new encounters and quests across the world, including a few jobs on the job board at the tavern in Capital City. Keep exploring, you might just stumble into something new!



Thanks everyone, hope you enjoy the update! Please report any issues to the #bug-reports channel in the Discord!
